evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator reported that a qualifying old ZIP file remained undeleted, directly testing whether every ZIP older than one year was deleted.

chains.rationale: The evaluator directly identifies the same unsatisfied deletion predicate and observed mechanism: an old ZIP remained after the agent adopted false prior progress, declared completion, and left Files. The frozen contribution is known and not concurrent, and recovery did not occur. The independently sufficient frozen defect newer_zip_deleted prevents a strong attribution because it separately violates the same delete-only-old predicate.

summary: For both chains, the evaluator directly confirmed the frozen affected predicate remained unsatisfied because an old ZIP was not deleted. Each preserved false completion plausibly contributed, but the independently sufficient deletion of a newer ZIP precludes strong attribution.
